title: The first orbital racing game has gravity bodies that pull and push
author: jaykrown
selftext:
**Game Title: Slingshot Speeders**

**Playable Link:** [https://slingshotspeeders.com/](https://slingshotspeeders.com/)

**Platform:** Web browser

**Description:** Slingshot Speeders is the first orbital racing game. The first game whose race is the act of executing an orbital trajectory and capturing a closed orbit under real gravity. Browser-native 2D real-time orbital-mechanics racing game in which players use real inverse-square gravity and slingshots to capture a closed orbit, with time/fuel performance and a public leaderboard as the competitive loop.

**Free to Play Status:**

* \[x\] Free to play

**Involvement:** Creator and developer

A bit competitive at this point. That map is called "Hopscotch". The specific link to it is here: [https://slingshotspeeders.com/m/o5jugegg](https://slingshotspeeders.com/m/o5jugegg)

Free to play in browser, with no account required. Race within real inverse-square gravity.

[https://slingshotspeeders.com/](https://slingshotspeeders.com/)

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body: Inverse square is crazy work. More real than KSP! :P

replies.author: jaykrown
replies.body:
KSP has been a major inspiration, it's a great game. The specific inspiration was the Kraken drive bug in KSP2 which I used to speed run to the Mun and back. 

Slingshot Speeders is definitely quicker and tighter, but uses the same fundamental concepts. If you have any suggestions or feedback I'm all ears, thanks for commenting.

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body:
Same for me! Big inspo the way it teaches stuff. Have spent countless hours in it <3   
  
I have some basic feedback/suggestions from a noobs perspective hope it helps 

* Put your PLAY button atop the leaderboards on splash/landing so people find it faster/easier.  
* Putting control scheme front and centre too not midway into how to play. It's first thing I had issues with. I assumed WASD but some others are super useful. Bonus points if I can access it while racing/in-game - a fair few things to remember. 
* Once I've already done the \~80mb download, re-clicking play re-downloads the client again I think. Seems I'm unloading/loading it by moving between menus. Seems like a bug/needless slowdown/bandwidth for you to re-serve it like that. 
* Q/E rotation seems oddly locked/fixed like I can't rotate to burn at right angle but IDK, only been messing with it for \~10 min! In KSP terms it's like I am locked to prograde on navball, while I try to turn elsewhere. 

https://preview.redd.it/wp25qervzhrh1.png?width=514&format=png&auto=webp&s=7a48fd8f368383c1fa93378812f53c569940823d

My intuition is to wait until I'm roughly at periapsis, face the way the arrow does, and burn to escape orbit, but am struggling w it >.<

replies.author: jaykrown
replies.body:
Thank you, I really appreciate you mentioning these, it's really helpful. When you were having the rotation issue, was it on the multiplayer test map? I suspect this may be an issue with desync high latency with the server.

The re-download definitely should not be happening, I'll investigate why it may have happened for you. Did it happen every time, or just once? I will move the controls to the top of the how to play. The play buttons are relative for the maps, each map has its own play button.

Thanks again!

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body:
"Yay I'm helping" /zoidberg voice

I just realized there are many play buttons embedded in each leaderboard, haha. So previous advice kinda was misplaced. Still, make those stand out imo then you are idiot proofed against idiots like me. 

It was the multiplayer map yes, the one via play at bottom of page.   


As for repro loop on download: take typical NPE (new player experience) like I had and just re-tested:  download at home page > how to play > click play via menu or play the game link > redownload happens. So it may just be that one page.

replies.author: jaykrown
replies.body:
You are helping! Good to know that the rotation issue was in the multiplayer test, I'll investigate that issue. It definitely has something to do with server synchronization in the multiplayer session and never seems to happen during solo runs. I'll make the play and other buttons a bit larger.

The how to play page is a part of the parallel single page web application. Loading back to play should be cached and rapid. This is because building the entire profile system and all the informational pages in html/css/js was significantly easier, and kept the Bevy 0.19 wasm focused purely on the game simulation. Maybe what I'll just do is see if I can have it open another tab instead of replacing the current page.

Thanks again for testing and mentioning all this, it seriously helps. My brain is starting to get fried at this point. 😅

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body: I think tab solution is a good fix. Lets ppl also consult controls while game is up, so 2 birds temporarily smooshed with one stone.

replies.author: jaykrown
replies.body: Also, interestingly if you go from in-game to the how to play, and then click the back button in browser, it seems to instantly load back into the homepage of the game. I'll learn more about why that works that way.
